SilentStreamReconnects.summary: The SSE client flips the pill off on error, and never notices a silent stream.
SilentStreamReconnects.why: connect() creates one EventSource. onerror sets the pill to off and relies on the browser to retry a broken socket. Comment pings from the server are not events, and the client has no timer, so a half-open stream stays Live.
SilentStreamReconnects.codePath: Pinned school-pulse 3b76b08. Client connect is web/app.ts:466-479. Server comment ping is src/server/server.ts:110-116.
SilentStreamReconnects.repro: Same npm test run. The new test expected connect() to start a silence timer or call reconnect. The function only sets the pill off inside onerror. The assertion failed. No draft PR was opened on BoydVC/school-pulse.
